# HygiaTrade / Хигия Трейд ООД

HygiaTrade is the website of Хигия Трейд ООД (Hygia Trade Ltd.), a Bulgarian distributor and supplier of laundry detergents, cleaning products, hygiene consumables and related products for households and business customers.

## SANO distribution

Хигия Трейд ООД is listed by SANO Bulgaria as the SANO distributor for the area of:
- Русе / Ruse
- Силистра / Silistra
- Разград / Razgrad
- Свищов / Svishtov
- Бяла / Byala
- Търговище / Targovishte

Official third-party verification from SANO Bulgaria:
https://sanobg.com/buy/

Primary SANO page on HygiaTrade:
https://higiatrade.com/sano/

## Products and services

HygiaTrade supplies and accepts enquiries for:
- SANO laundry detergents
- SANO cleaning products
- household cleaning products
- professional cleaning products
- laundry products
- paper hygiene products
- cleaning tools and consumables
- supplies for shops, offices and business customers
